fields.mechanism: Shot-to-shot compensation mechanism that accumulates and transfers learning results across consecutive shots.
fields.intervention: Implement a cycle‑to‑cycle accumulation of viscosity estimates derived from measured flow rates, storing them in a passive lookup table that updates the P‑07 model’s viscosity parameter before each new prediction.
fields.expected_effect: Reduces parameter estimation error by continuously refining the viscosity parameter with historical flow data, keeping model predictions within the required tolerance.
fields.falsification_test: Compare the P‑07 model’s viscosity predictions against benchmark measurements over 100 injection cycles with and without the shot‑to‑shot accumulation; a statistically significant reduction in estimation error (e.g., >20% RMSE decrease) validates the intervention.
